Package io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.stage

Class ActionResult

java.lang.Object
io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.stage.ActionResult
public final class ActionResult extends Object
Outcome returned by a directed action handler: the EvalResult plus optional output, error, triggers, extra state updates, custom stage override, events, and deadline.
